notes: Demo project bootstrapped from NHS PROMs experimental notebooks. Data sourced from England NHS 1 dataset (2016-17 to 2018-19). Target: 'health_gain' (regression).

upload_cfg.derived_outcome_formula: Knee Replacement Post-Op Q Score - Knee Replacement Pre-Op Q Score

datasets.name: Manual Imputation
datasets.notes:
Source: notebooks/Experiment/Knee/data/interim/2.1-train/test.parquet
Strategy: manual, domain-guided imputation of missing values. Includes engineered features: comorbidity_burden, depression interactions.

datasets.name: Median / Mode + Flags
datasets.description: Median/mode imputation with missingness indicator columns
datasets.notes:
Source: notebooks/Experiment/Knee/prepared_datasets/pipeline2_median_mode_*.parquet
Strategy: numeric → median, categorical → mode. Adds *_missing flag columns for Age Band, Gender and Pre-Op questionnaire items.

datasets.name: MICE Imputation
datasets.description: Multiple Imputation by Chained Equations (MICE / IterativeImputer)
datasets.notes:
Source: notebooks/Experiment/Knee/prepared_datasets/pipeline3_mice_*.parquet
Strategy: sklearn IterativeImputer (BayesianRidge estimator, 10 iterations). Same missingness flags as pipeline2 but imputed values differ.

datasets.name: Reduced Features
datasets.description: Smaller feature set — rare comorbidities and redundant columns removed
datasets.notes:
Source: notebooks/Experiment/Knee/prepared_datasets/pipeline4_reduced_features_*.parquet
Dropped: Cancer, Circulation, Depression (separate), Heart Disease, Kidney Disease, Liver Disease, Lung Disease, Nervous System, Revision Flag, Pre-Op Q Living Arrangements_3/4/null. Useful for checking whether rare features genuinely improve the model.

datasets.name: Reduced Features — Classification
datasets.description: Reduced feature set with binary outcome (NO_Benefit). Target: NO_Benefit.
datasets.notes:
Source: notebooks/Experiment/Knee/data/interim/2.7-cls-*.parquet
Target: NO_Benefit (binary). Engineered from reduced feature set.
datasets.pipeline_method: Manual prep | reduced features | binary outcome

datasets.name: Reduced Features — Regression
datasets.description: Reduced feature set with continuous health_gain target.
datasets.notes:
Source: notebooks/Experiment/Knee/data/interim/2.7-reg-*.parquet
Target: health_gain (regression). Reduced comorbidity set.
